policy:public.medication_takes.personal_.using:
((current_setting('med_tracker.personal_history_access'::text, true) = 'true'::text) AND ((schedule_id IN ( SELECT schedules.id
   FROM schedules
  WHERE (schedules.person_id = ( SELECT accounts.person_id
           FROM accounts
          WHERE ((accounts.id = med_tracker.current_account_id()) AND (accounts.status = 2) AND accounts.active))))) OR (person_medication_id IN ( SELECT person_medications.id
   FROM person_medications
  WHERE (person_medications.person_id = ( SELECT accounts.person_id
           FROM accounts
          WHERE ((accounts.id = med_tracker.current_account_id()) AND (accounts.status = 2) AND accounts.active)))))))

policy:public.medications.personal_histo.using:
((current_setting('med_tracker.personal_history_access'::text, true) = 'true'::text) AND ((id IN ( SELECT medication_takes.taken_from_medication_id
   FROM medication_takes)) OR (id IN ( SELECT schedules.medication_id
   FROM schedules)) OR (id IN ( SELECT person_medications.medication_id
   FROM person_medications))))

rule:public.personal_taken_doses._RETURN.definition:
CREATE RULE "_RETURN" AS
    ON SELECT TO public.personal_taken_doses DO INSTEAD  SELECT medication_takes.id,
    COALESCE(schedules.person_id, person_medications.person_id) AS person_id,
    medication_takes.taken_at,
    medication_takes.dose_amount,
    medication_takes.dose_unit,
    medications.name AS medicine
   FROM ((((medication_takes
     LEFT JOIN schedules ON ((schedules.id = medication_takes.schedule_id)))
     LEFT JOIN person_medications ON ((person_medications.id = medication_takes.person_medication_id)))
     JOIN accounts ON ((accounts.person_id = COALESCE(schedules.person_id, person_medications.person_id))))
     JOIN medications ON ((medications.id = COALESCE(medication_takes.taken_from_medication_id, schedules.medication_id, person_medications.medication_id))))
  WHERE ((accounts.id = med_tracker.current_account_id()) AND (accounts.status = 2) AND (medication_takes.taken_at IS NOT NULL));
